hooks.command: grep -qsF 'renice 10 -p $$' "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" && exit 0; n=$(getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN); j=$((n > 1 ? n - 1 : 1)); b=$(sysctl -n hw.memsize 2>/dev/null || echo $(($(getconf _PHYS_PAGES 2>/dev/null || echo 0) * $(getconf PAGESIZE)))); m=$((b / 4194304)); g=; [ "$m" -gt 0 ] && g="export GOMEMLIMIT=\${GOMEMLIMIT:-${m}MiB}"; printf '%s\n' 'renice 10 -p $$ >/dev/null 2>&1' "export CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=\${CARGO_BUILD_JOBS:-$j} GOMAXPROCS=\${GOMAXPROCS:-$j}" "$g" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"

IN=$(cat); case "$IN" in *'"prompt":"/claudetto:setup"'*|*'"prompt":"/claudetto:setup '*) printf '%s' '{"decision":"block","reason":"Setup did not run: claudetto plugin code is not running in this session. Restart Claude Code; if it still fails, reinstall claudetto."}';; esac
